messages:
mike: kicking off a lightweight access review run for admin bindings + unlabeled KMS keys. plan: 3d self-attest, 14d quarantine (console/API disabled + tag=quarantine), 60d archive snapshot then possible rotation/destruction. please volunteer owners for items you touch.

anya: ack. i'll run a quick ownerless scan and share results. small checklist: list owner-role bindings, list KMS key principals, export to S3/GS.

carl: paste the minimal commands pls so oncall can run nightly job.

anya: commands i use (short):
```
# GCP owners
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $P --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("owner|roles/owner"))'

# GCP KMS keys
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=$KR --format=json | jq '.[] | {name,labels,primary}
\n# AWS KMS
aws kms list-keys --output text | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms describe-key --key-id {} --query 'KeyMetadata.{KeyId:KeyId,AWSAccountId:AWSAccountId}'
```

anya: upload: gs://redwood-security/review/3042106789-ownerless.csv (7 rows). sample row: svcacct-billing@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com,owner=null

mike: assigned owners in sheet: svcacct-billing -> @carl; key-payments -> @anya. will create infra ledger PR to persist owners.

carl: proposed remediation flow: if no owner in 3d -> disable console/API and set label `orphaned:pending`. If resource used by prod in 14d, SRE will rotate keys and update creds; else archive snapshot and schedule destroy after retention ack.

attest-bot: attestation:started ts=3042106789 scope=org scan=ownerless-resources

infra-bot: infra:pr_created repo=infra-owners pr=987 add_entries=[svcacct-billing,key-payments]

mike: thanks. follow-ups: (1) @anya add playbook snippet for rotation and proof-of-rotation artifact (2) @carl add terraform gating to block new owner bindings without CODEOWNERS signoff. reconvene in 10 days if >5 orphans. :calendar:
